One of the Most Disappointing Dining Experiences in Ho Chi Minh
Mar 2025 • Couples
I rarely write reviews like this, but my recent visit to Meet and Meat left me deeply frustrated and genuinely disappointed.

Let me be clear — I understand that staff are just doing their job. But the way things are handled here speaks volumes about the management’s attitude toward customer satisfaction. I walked in genuinely excited to enjoy a good cut of beef, but instead I was forced into choosing from a limited, frankly unappealing menu that I didn’t want. I expressed interest in another option — one that I know was available — but was met with indifference.

This isn’t just about food. It’s about how you treat your customers. Instead of being flexible or even showing a bit of care, the staff (under management direction, I assume) stuck rigidly to an inflexible, uninspired offering that clearly doesn’t put customer experience first.

The result? You lost out on a happy customer and potentially repeat business — all because of a poor approach to hospitality and common sense. I left my meal untouched because I simply didn’t want what was forced on me.

Terrible experience. Would not recommend, and I’ll make sure others know to spend their money elsewhere?
